as_told.title: Calf dies with a UFO caught on camera above it

plain: A healthy two-year-old cow was found dead on Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for strange reports, with no marks on its body, and cameras had caught an object above it. Michels tells it from the TV series The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch as one of the most disturbing things ever to happen there. The ranch's owner, Brandon Fugal, tells it at first hand, placing it in a field near the ranch's Homestead 1 and crediting a ranch worker named Thomas Winterton and a man named Caleb Benches. If true, something in the sky may have killed the animal.
